page.title: Milkbox
page.subtitle: With a splash of charm.
page.heroDescription: Featuring a kawaii milk carton design with UV-printed front panels that won’t scratch or peel, and a magnetic straw that adds the perfect cherry on top. Bound to be a conversation piece and an adorable addition to your gaming setup, each Milkbox also comes with a super cute sticker sheet. Available in Whole Milk, Banana Milk, and Strawberry Milk flavors.

embed.title: Milkbox ｜ A Limited Edition PC by Ironside

content.title: The Cream of the Gaming Crop
content.description: The Milkbox PC combines an adorable, milk-carton-inspired design, bringing a super playful and unique touch to your setup.

content.title: A Splash of Charm
content.description: Adding the perfect playful touch, the Milkbox’s magnetic straw perfectly captures the look of a real life milk carton; and since it’s magnetically attached, you get all the charm without any concern about it breaking off during use or transport. Paired with the nutrition specs printed on the side, Milkbox is all about playful, thoughtful details.

content.title: Fresh Prints Don’t Spoil
content.description: With UV-printed panels that resist scratches and peeling, the Milkbox PC’s vibrant milk-carton design stays pristine.

content.title: Banana Milk 🍌
content.description: Sweet & Sunny – With a pop of yellow, Banana Milk is undeniably playful and energetic.

content.title: Whole Milk 🥛
content.description: Fresh & Classic – With soft blues inspired by classic dairy cartons, Whole Milk keeps things refreshing and timeless.

content.title: Strawberry Milk 🍓
content.description: Berry Sweet – Wrapped in a rosy pink, the Strawberry Milk brings a joyful, lighthearted touch to your space.

content.title: Chocolate Milk 🍫
content.description: Retired // Rich & Cozy – The Chocolate Milk Milkbox brings warm, comforting tones for a cozy vibe.

items.title: Proven Performance
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully built to deliver balanced, reliable performance for gaming, creative work, and everyday tasks. Each system undergoes extended testing to ensure stability and longevity, even after years of intense usage.

items.title: Backed by Warranty
items.description: We stand behind our gaming computers with an unrivaled, 3 year parts and lifetime labor Ironside Warranty at no additional charge.

items.title: Shipped with Care
items.description: Every Ironside PC is carefully packaged to arrive safely at your door. We use double boxing and custom internal packaging to keep components secure during transit, so your system arrives exactly as intended.

items.title: Built by Family. Powered by Passion.
items.description: We’re more than a gaming PC company. We’re a family. Founded by four siblings, Ironside has always been a personal project, built with love, care, and respect for craftsmanship. What started in a Las Vegas garage is now a company still run with the same hands-on spirit and attention to detail.
